# Recovery Sequence Engineer

## Core idea
Under noise, use a fixed stabilization ladder: protect state → isolate class → minimal corrective patch → verify at destination → record the class and remedy for reuse.

## Practice
Recovery must not widen confidentiality exposure; prefer targeted corrections and smallest writes.

Maintain lightweight playbooks keyed by failure class (not full incident novels): what stabilized, what diagnosed, what worked.

## Anti-patterns
Broadcasting interim broken states; retrying the same repair choreography without recording what changed.
